meta_title: Hedge and Home | Landscape Gardener Manchester
meta_description: Hedge and Home is a landscape gardener in Manchester offering garden design, planting, and maintenance. Transform your outdoor space today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces, we design and maintain gardens that work harder and look better.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From one-off garden overhauls to year-round maintenance, we handle every aspect of creating and caring for outdoor spaces that add value and enjoyment.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We handle everything from initial consultation through to detailed planting schemes and hardscaping layouts.

services.title: Planting & Landscaping
services.desc: Professional planting of trees, shrubs, and borders using plants suited to Manchester's climate. We create focal points and year-round colour in your garden.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge and shrub cutting to keep boundaries neat and healthy. We work to your preferred height and shape, keeping your garden looking maintained.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Up
services.desc: Complete overgrowth removal, dead wood clearance, and garden reset. Perfect for new properties or gardens that need a fresh start.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Quality hard landscaping that extends your living space. We lay patios, decking, and pathways designed to blend with your garden scheme.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Care
services.desc: Spring cleanup, autumn leaf clearing, winter preparation, and summer maintenance. Keep your garden looking its best throughout the year.

about_pullquote: A good garden isn't a luxury—it's an investment in your home and your wellbeing.
about_para_1: Hedge and Home was founded on the belief that every Manchester homeowner deserves access to professional landscape design without the premium prices. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation for honest advice, meticulous work, and gardens that genuinely transform properties. We treat every project—whether a border refresh or a complete garden redesign—with the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen. We don't impose grand designs that don't suit your space or budget; instead, we work within your vision and show you what's possible. From East Manchester to Stockport, we've built relationships with families who trust us to maintain their gardens season after season.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Hedge and Home

reviews.text: We'd had the garden for three years and done nothing with it. Craig came round, listened to what we wanted, and drew up a plan that was actually affordable. The transformation is unreal—neighbours keep asking for his number. Brilliant bloke.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had him trim our hedge twice a year for five years now. Always on time, tidy workers, fair pricing. Doesn't try to upsell you on things you don't need. That's rare.
reviews.author: Margaret P.

reviews.text: Cleared our entire overgrown back garden and laid a new patio. The work was immaculate and they left the site spotless. Would 100% recommend to anyone in the area.
reviews.author: James K.
